FloodLens summary · 26 Aug 2026

Change detection estimates 18.4 km² of flood or debris exposure along the selected corridor. The pre-event road overlay identifies 12 impacted segments and 3 bridges requiring review. Network analysis flags Timure and Syabrubesi as potentially disconnected from the nearest response point.

Use this as a prioritization aid only. Confirm conditions with local authorities and field teams.

Ready. Choose an area and flood date, then run the analysis workflow.

FloodLens AI is an educational prototype, not an operational safety system. Planned data inputs: Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, Copernicus DEM, and a pre-event OpenStreetMap snapshot. Required final attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2026. © OpenStreetMap contributors.
